howto.what: 把你的 Discord 机器人接进 NanoClaw:从 channels 分支复制 Discord 适配器并注册,安装 @chat-adapter/discord@4.29.0,构建并跑注册测试,再引导你建机器人、粘贴 Bot Token、写入凭据、重启服务,并开通私聊频道。
howto.when: 当你需要给 NanoClaw 添加 Discord 机器人频道时会用到它;原文未写明触发关键词。

say.text: 帮我把 Discord 机器人频道接入 NanoClaw
say.note: 走复制适配器、注册、装依赖、构建测试的 Apply 步骤

say.text: 这是我的 Discord Bot Token,帮我配好凭据
say.note: 会校验 token 并推导出应用 ID 与公钥

say.text: 重启服务,让 Discord 适配器生效
say.note: 运行 restart.sh 并等待 CLI socket

howto.what_en: Adds a Discord bot channel to NanoClaw: copies the Discord adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs @chat-adapter/discord@4.29.0, then guides bot creation, Bot Token entry, credential setup and a service restart.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to add a Discord bot channel to NanoClaw; the original text doesn't list trigger keywords.

say_en.text: Add the Discord bot channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Runs the Apply steps: adapter copy, registration, dependency, build and test

say_en.text: Here's my Discord Bot Token — set up the credentials.
say_en.note: Validates the token and derives the app ID and public key

say_en.text: Restart the service so the Discord adapter loads.
say_en.note: Runs restart.sh and waits for the CLI socket
